claims: Rain is liquid water that condenses from atmospheric vapor and falls to Earth when droplets become too heavy.
Rain occurs when temperatures are above freezing.
Light rain is less than 0.10 inches per hour.
Moderate rain is 0.10 to 0.30 inches per hour.
Heavy rain is greater than 0.30 inches per hour.
According to the National Environmental Satellite, Data, and Information Service (.gov), water vapor condenses around particles like dust or pollen in clouds before falling.
Convective rain forms from rising hot air.
Frontal rain occurs at weather fronts.
According to The Weather Channel, a clipper system is expected to bring a mix of rain and snow to the Northeast US this weekend.

According to www.rain.app.com, Rain (app) is a financial platform for earned wage access.
According to Tara Brach, RAIN (mindfulness) is an acronym for a meditation practice (Recognize, Allow, Investigate, Nurture).
According to www.rain.aero, Rain (wildfire) is an autonomous wildfire management technology.
